findings: The deterministic responsive harness generated and passed 209 captures at 1440px desktop, 768px tablet and 390px mobile across dark and light themes with no overflow, contrast, touch-target, selector or runtime failures.

Four captures were reviewed pixel-by-pixel by the named reviewer, covering both surfaces this session changed in both themes and at both desktop and mobile widths; the remaining retained captures are hash-bound but were validated by the harness rather than individually eyeballed, and that distinction is stated rather than blurred.

Draft room at 1440px light renders YOU ARE ON THE CLOCK with the available-prospect row exposing both Select and Draft actions. This is the exact control that threw a ReferenceError before this session and never issued the pick request; it now renders and is reachable.

Draft room at 390px dark keeps the war room, live pick market and available-prospect table legible, with the prospects table scrolling horizontally inside its own container rather than forcing the page to scroll.

Overview command deck at 1440px dark shows no critical contract-expired alert on a fresh week-1 league. Before this session every 84-plus-rated player produced a false critical banner rendering a literal undefined for position; the banner region is now correctly silent.
Overview at 390px light preserves the same corrected alert behaviour and full theme parity, with no undefined string rendered on any surveyed surface.

The Opening Contract first-run tutorial captures are retained unchanged from the harness and show the reserved panel space and stable first paint established in Session 85 still intact at this candidate.
inspection.scopeNote: The draft pick reveal modal itself is not in this capture set: it only appears after a live on-the-clock pick is committed, which the deterministic harness does not drive. Its correctness is covered by executable tests rather than pixels, and that gap is recorded rather than implied closed.
